You will work closely with operations teams, engineering teams, customers, vendors, and business stakeholders to deliver strategic network solutions, optimize service delivery, and guide the adoption of emerging technologies. Key Responsibilities: Lead the end-to-end design, architecture, implementation, and optimization of enterprise and service provider network infrastructure. Define network architecture standards, technical roadmaps, engineering guidelines, and best practices to support business growth and technology evolution. Design and optimize complex routing and switching environments, including BGP, MP-BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, MPLS L2/L3 VPN, EVPN, VXLAN, and advanced traffic engineering. Architect highly available and resilient network solutions with appropriate redundancy, failover, disaster recovery, and business continuity capabilities. Lead Tier 3 escalations and critical incident investigations, driving root cause analysis, corrective actions, and long-term service reliability improvements. Oversee major network transformation projects, including backbone upgrades, network migrations, data center connectivity, carrier interconnections, and high-capacity circuit deployments. Drive network capacity planning, traffic forecasting, bandwidth optimization, and infrastructure scalability across core, aggregation, and access networks. Establish network security architecture and design principles covering segmentation, firewall integration, secure routing, VPNs, access control, and infrastructure hardening. Evaluate and introduce new network technologies, platforms, and solutions to improve reliability, scalability, security, and operational efficiency. Lead technical assessments, architecture reviews, proof-of-concept activities, and technology selection in collaboration with vendors and internal stakeholders. Drive network automation and standardization initiatives using appropriate scripting, configuration management, and orchestration technologies. Define network monitoring, telemetry, observability, and performance management strategies to support proactive fault detection and service assurance. Establish change management, implementation, validation, and rollback standards for high-risk network changes. Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and knowledge transfer to network engineers and operations teams.
